As a Lead IT Specialist (Program Manager), GS-2210-14, you will serve as the senior technical lead responsible for planning, coordinating, integrating, and delivering a mission-critical enterprise applications development program supporting public claims submission, claims processing, adjudication, and payment.

You will provide technical leadership and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful program execution. Specific duties include: Lead the planning, execution, integration, and delivery of complex enterprise IT programs and digital modernization initiatives.

Develop and manage integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, delivery roadmaps, and performance measures to ensure successful project execution. Coordinate enterprise applications, case management systems, cybersecurity, contractors, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, integrated technology solutions.

Lead enterprise systems integration by ensuring interoperability across applications, APIs, workflows, identity management, data platforms, and legacy systems. Identify and resolve technical, operational, and organizational risks, dependencies, and integration challenges affecting project delivery.

Establish and maintain project governance processes, monitor contractor performance, and ensure compliance with federal IT lifecycle, acquisition, and project management requirements.

Integrate cybersecurity requirements throughout the system development lifecycle, coordinate Security Assessment and Authorization (SA&A) activities, and serve as the System Owner responsible for achieving and maintaining the Authority to Operate (ATO).

Ensure compliance with Department of Justice cybersecurity policies, NIST standards, and other applicable federal security and privacy requirements. Provide technical leadership, assign and review work, mentor Information Technology Specialists, and advise the Assistant Chief Information Officer (ACIO) on program execution and strategic initiatives.

Prepare and deliver executive briefings, governance reports, and recommendations to senior Department leadership, including the Assistant CIO, Senior Executive Service officials, Justice Management Division, and the Office of Management and Budget.

Collaborate with business owners and technical stakeholders to gather requirements, support user acceptance testing, manage organizational change, and facilitate successful deployment of enterprise technology solutions.
To qualify for the position of Lead IT Specialist (Program Manager), at GS-2210-14, you must meet the basic qualification requirements listed below.

Applicants must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-13 level in the Federal service that demonstrates experience in the following areas: Leading complex enterprise information technology projects or programs; Coordinating enterprise applications, systems integration efforts, and cross-functional technical teams; Managing IT project schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, resources, and deliverables; Integrating cybersecurity requirements, security controls, and risk management activities into IT solutions throughout the system lifecycle; and Providing technical guidance, recommendations, and project status briefings to senior leadership and stakeholders.

You MUST meet all qualification requirements by the 07/31/2026 of this announcement. Your resume must support your responses to the application questionnaire and the qualification requirements. Failure to do so may result in an ineligible rating. See the Required Documents section for important notes about what must be included in your resume.

Troubleshooting and diagnoses system integration malfunctions, identifying technical anomalies in data pipelines, and implementing code/rule modifications to optimize data accuracy, minimize latency, and resolve critical operational sync issues.

Acts as the principal technical authority and subject matter expert for the design, development, and integration of the agency's comprehensive HRIS landscape, aligning cloud-based HR systems with complex federal HR policies and civil service regulations.

Engineers and leads highly complex, secure HRIS integrations that span multiple federal agencies, ensuring seamless data exchange and synchronization with OPM data standards, federal reporting streams, and government-wide HR systems modernization initiatives. Conducts in-depth analytical reviews of market trends and emerging HRIT technologies.

Evaluates these solutions against functional human capital requirements, providing data-driven recommendations to leadership that balance business benefits with performance constraints and technical risks.
You must meet both the Basic Requirement and the Specialized Experience to qualify for this series as described below. BASIC REQUIREMENT: Applicants must have IT-related education and experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below at a proficiency level equivalent to the next lower grade level in federal service.

Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: In addition, to the basic requirement.

A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level GS-13 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as meeting 2 out of 4 of the following: Leading the technical implementation of comprehensive cloud-based Human Resources Information System (HRIS) landscapes, ensuring alignment with federal HR policies, cross-agency integration standards, and critical Office of Personnel Management (OPM) data exchanges.

Performing hands-on software engineering to sustain custom applications and platforms that extend native (HRIS) capabilities.

Improving highly complex, secure, real-time data exchanges using Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and secure batch data transfers (e.g., SFTP) between an enterprise HRIS (such as Workday) and other auxiliary enterprise systems.

Applying federal security frameworks and architectures (such as FedRAMP, NIST, OMB, and agency-specific mandates) to secure high-impact cloud-based HR systems and integrations. "Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience.

Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

CTAP/ICTAP candidates: To be considered "well qualified" you must meet all of the requirements as described in this section. You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

As a IT Specialist (Applications Software), you will perform the following duties: Serve as a Geospatial Data Engineer applying mastery level expertise to initiate and lead application software development projects through development, coding, testing, evaluating, operational implementation and support of software.

Utilize applications including Python, Integrated Development Environments, XML and geospatial applications such as QGIS to support cloud-based computing for National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) hydrographic data acquisition platforms and Office of Coast Survey (OCS).

Lead and ensure continuous and efficient operation of NOAA hydrographic platforms and Coast Survey office by providing timely support of operational software, including in-house and third-party software, and their integration. Lead the analysis of existing software and systems to identify opportunities for improvement, automation, and efficiency.

Develop and implement plans for the operational transition of new software and systems. Provide subject matter expertise for the development of documentation for new software and systems, including requirements and specifications, test plans and reports, and standard operating procedures.

Coordinate with other NOAA offices, government agencies, academic partners, and industry through working groups, conferences, and meetings to identify and promote collaborative work and best practices. Conduct training on new software, systems, and procedures undergoing transition to operational use.

NOTE: These duties are described at the full performance level of the ZP-4; the ZP-3 is developmental leading to such performance. This position will be filled under the DOC Alternative Personnel System (CAPS). Under CAPS, positions are classified by career, pay plan, and pay band. The ZP-3 is equivalent to the GS-11/12.

The ZP-4 is equivalent to the GS-13/14.
Qualification requirements in the vacancy announcements are based on the U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards Handbook, which contains federal qualification standards.

This handbook is available on the Office of Personnel Management's website located at: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/ EDUCATION: There is no positive education requirement for this position.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must possess one year of specialized experience equivalent in difficulty and responsibility to the next lower grade level in the Federal Service.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped the applicant with the particular competencies/knowledge, skills and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. This experience need not have been in the federal government.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations e.g., professional; philanthropic, religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies; knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

To qualify for the 2210 series: IT COMPETENCIES: For all positions individuals qualifying based on experience must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below.

The employing agency is responsible for identifying the specific level of proficiency required for each competency at each grade level based on the requirements of the position being filled. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. -AND- To qualify at the ZP-3 or GS-11 level: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: In addition to meeting the IT Competencies above, applicants must also possess one full year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to the ZP-2or GS-09 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience MUST include all of the following: Working with cloud-based computing systems and utilizing applications such as Python, Integrated Development Environments, and XML; and Monitoring the operations of systems to ensure they are functioning properly and that Information Technology (IT) protocols are met.

OR SUBSTITUTION OF EDUCATION: A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management or degree that provided a minimum of 24 semester hours in one or more of the fields identified above and required the development or adaptation of applications, systems or networks or 3 full years of progressively higher graduate education leading to a Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree.

To qualify at the ZP-4 or GS-13 level: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: In addition to meeting the IT Competencies above, applicants must also possess one full year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to the ZP-3 or GS-12 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience MUST include all of the following: Supporting real-time data operations for cloud-based computing systems, utilizing applications such as Python, Integrated Development Environments, and XML; Performing Information Technology (IT) system administration and operations projects in support of development, testing and deployment of applications; and Participating in the installation and support of new or existing applications (e.g. the design, development, testing and debugging, installation, support of applications, etc.).

**IMPORTANT PLEASE READ** This announcement contains a two-phase process. Upon completion of Phase 1, you must click on the exclusive link to complete the manual assessment. The next phase it will take one hour, at a minimum, to complete. The following are the duties of this position at the GS-13.

If you are selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform all these duties and will receive training to help you grow in this position. Serve as a seasoned data engineer responsible for developing data ETL pipelines in Python and Spark.

Craft data storage and processing solutions using structured query language (SQL), unstructured query language (NoSQL), and/or commercial cloud services. Catalog metadata and create automated data quality and integrity checks.

Create and advise on software templates and standards to be used by other offices for their migration to cloud infrastructure. Receive, evaluate and responds to user requests for special purpose reports drawn from various databases.
You must meet the following requirements by the closing date of this announcement. The experience may have been gained in either the public, private sector or volunteer service. One year of experience refers to full-time work; part-time work is considered on a prorated basis.

To ensure full credit for your work experience, please indicate dates of employment by month/day/year, and indicate number of hours worked per week on your résumé. For the GS-13, you must have one year (full 52 weeks) of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: - Leading enterprise data engineering modernization across cloud, hybrid, multi-cloud, or large-scale data environments. AND - Establishing architecture standards and reusable patterns for data integration, governance, metadata, virtualization, data mesh, automation, and cloud migration.

AND - Advising technical teams, leaders, and stakeholders on platform strategy, scalable pipelines, APIs, data services, ETL/ELT, data quality, security, AI-ready data, and AWS or Azure implementation.

For the GS-12, you must have one year (full 52 weeks) of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-11 grade level in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: - Independently developing and optimizing data engineering solutions for large or complex datasets, including ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, and cloud-based workflows AND - Integrating data from multiple sources using modern tools such as scripting languages, query languages, APIs, AWS, Azure, NoSQL, or distributed processing technologies.

AND - Implementing data quality, lineage, metadata, security, and governance controls to support analytics, dashboards, automation, AI/ML use cases, and reliable operations.

For the GS-11, you must have one year (full 52 weeks) of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: - Developing and maintaining data pipelines that extract, transform, load, validate, or move data across systems AND - Using modern data engineering tools such as scripting languages, query languages, APIs, Jupyter or cloud-based notebook environments, version control, and cloud services to clean, transform, validate, and automate data workflows.

AND - Supporting ETL/ELT processes, APIs, dashboards, reporting, documentation, quality checks, and preparation of datasets for analytics or AI/ML use cases In addition to meeting specialized experience, at the GS-12 and GS-13 level, individuals must have experience demonstrating each of the following competencies: Attention to Detail, Customer Service, Decision Making, Information Management, Interpersonal Skills, Oral Communication, Problem Solving, Teamwork, and Technical Competence.

In addition to meeting specialized experience, at the GS-11 level, individuals must have experience demonstrating each of the following competencies: Attention to Detail, Customer Service, Interpersonal Skills, Problem Solving, Teamwork, and Technical Competence. A work sample may be used to determine if you meet the required proficiency levels.

You will receive a sample job task or scenario to complete; or you will provide a writing sample.

For the required proficiency levels and competency definitions, please see the following link: Competency-Based Qualification Standard for the Information Technology Management Series, 2210 For Phase 2, you will access the exclusive link to complete the manual assessment provided at the end of the questionnaire.

The Enterprise IT Support Specialist provides day-to-day technical and operational support for Enterprise IT. This role is responsible for onboarding and offboarding employees, identity and access management, endpoint administration, and supporting the technologies employees rely on every day.
This is more than a traditional Help Desk role. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and leveraging AI and automation to make Enterprise IT more efficient.

Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for employees across hardware, software, SaaS applications, and collaboration tools.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve IT-related issues.
Manage onboarding, offboarding, account provisioning, and access changes.
Administer identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, user accounts, and permissions.
Configure, deploy, and support macOS and Windows devices using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms.
Document, prioritize, and resolve support requests using the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform.
Maintain IT assets, software licensing, and operational documentation.
Collaborate with other IT teams to resolve technical issues and improve Enterprise IT operations.

3+ years of experience in IT Support, Enterprise IT, or Systems Administration.
Experience supporting macOS and Windows environments.
Experience with identity and access management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Mobile Device Management (MDM).
Experience with cloud-based SaaS applications and ITSM platforms.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, organization, and customer service skills.
Self-starter with strong ownership, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Experience with JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Jamf, or similar platforms.
Experience with Jira Service Management.
Familiarity with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other automation tools.
AI-First Expectations
AI is transforming Enterprise IT, and we expect every member of our team to embrace it as part of how they work. Successful candidates will:
Think AI first before approaching repetitive or manual work.
Use AI to improve productivity, documentation, troubleshooting, and communication.
Identify opportunities to automate routine tasks and improve operational efficiency.
Continuously learn and apply new AI capabilities responsibly and securely.

Atticus is hiring an IT Specialist to own and mature our internal IT operations as we scale.

You’ll work closely with and report to the Information Security Manager, supporting day-to-day IT operations while helping improve the systems, processes, and tooling we rely on across endpoint device lifecycle management, identity and access, SaaS administration, and our broader cloud-first IT environment.

About us Atticus is a Melbourne-based scale-up founded in 2017, which offers the leading technology in document fact-checking. We are on a mission to ensure every critical document is accurate and defensible. Our software helps our customers (law firms, listed companies, and funds) fact-check critical documents before they are disclosed to market.

Our users love Atticus because we save them a lot of pain in high stakes work. We are a small, highly efficient team that relies on well-run internal systems to stay productive. As we grow, we are committed to preserving that speed while maintaining the security, reliability, and trust our customers expect.

That means giving our people simple, dependable tools and support, while ensuring our devices, access, and SaaS systems are managed in a secure and scalable way. About the role As our IT Specialist, you will keep Atticus ’s internal IT operations running smoothly while helping us build a more scalable, secure, and reliable technology environment.

You’ll act as a first point of contact with users, manage devices and access, improve integrations between platforms, and ensure our internal tools are reliable, secure, and easy to use. As a small and highly efficient company, this is a broad role suited to someone comfortable operating across multiple areas of IT.

You’ll need to take initiative, solve ambiguous or unfamiliar problems, follow through reliably, and balance responsive support with longer-term improvement work. From time to time, the role may involve after-hours support for our UK team, particularly for onboarding, offboarding, or urgent support needs.

You will also be accountable for driving the pace of projects that strengthen how we manage identity, devices, applications, data, and access. You’ll be working across a range of responsibilities that support the smooth running and ongoing improvement of our internal IT operations:

Internal IT support: Providing end-to-end technical support across user devices, applications, account access, and collaboration tools, helping staff resolve issues quickly with minimal disruption to their work.

Endpoint lifecycle management: Managing the full lifecycle of endpoint devices — primarily that our Apple fleet is consistently enrolled, configured, patched, and compliant, with a repeatable and well-documented lifecycle process from procurement through to retirement.

Apple device management & automation: Writing and maintaining scripts to support macOS administration, MDM workflows, app deployment, and compliance checks, improving consistency and scalability as we grow.

Identity & access management: Managing accounts, permissions, and access changes are managed accurately and promptly, onboarding and offboarding workflows are automated, and our IAM practices mature in line with the needs of the business.

SaaS & business systems administration: Managing and optimising core SaaS platforms to keep them reliable, secure, and well-integrated, while improving visibility and governance across the application stack.

Process improvement & automation: Identifying, prioritising, and improving manual IT processes to create faster workflows, reduce errors, and support a more scalable IT operation.

Security-aligned operations: Partnering with the Information Security Manager to ensure IT operations support broader security objectives across devices, users, applications, and access.

Documentation: Developing and maintaining technical documentation, runbooks, and user guides for end users, IT/security stakeholders, and future team members.
About you We’re looking for a capable and proactive IT professional with 3+ years of experience in IT, systems administration, endpoint management, IT operations, or a similar role. You enjoy helping people solve practical technology problems, but also care about improving the systems, processes, and automation that reduce friction over time.

You have a strong sense of ownership, are comfortable working independently in a broad role, and are looking for an opportunity to take greater ownership of a modern, cloud-first internal IT environment.

You have hands-on experience managing user devices, access, SaaS platforms, and identity-related tooling, and are comfortable balancing responsive support with longer-term improvement work.

You do not need to have worked with every tool we use, but you should be practical, curious, technically confident, and willing to learn unfamiliar systems when needed. So if you’ve got the following skills and capabilities then please get in touch:

Internal IT & user support: Experience providing end-to-end technical support across hardware, software, accounts, collaboration tools, and internal systems, including troubleshooting, escalations, and Apple device support.

Endpoint & device management: Solid understanding of endpoint management in macOS and Apple environments, including MDM, device enrolment, configuration, app deployment, patching, compliance, and the full device lifecycle.

Apple administration & scripting: Strong working knowledge of macOS administration with the ability to write or maintain scripts for Apple/Unix environments to support MDM workflows, app deployment, reporting, and repeatable IT operations.

Identity & access management: Experience managing identities, accounts, permissions, and lifecycle processes across business systems, with an understanding of identity providers, MFA, SSO, SCIM, and centralised access management.

SaaS & business systems administration: Experience managing and optimising SaaS platforms, including user access, configuration, integrations, and documentation, with an interest in reducing complexity and unmanaged technology sprawl.

Security & compliance awareness: Familiarity with security frameworks and how organisations implement security controls, with comfort working in environments where IT supports security, auditability, and customer trust.

Provide expert technical leadership in the management, diagnosis, and resolution of highly complex enterprise system, network, application, and infrastructure issues with significant mission, operational, or organizational impact.
Evaluate emerging technologies, best practices, and evolving federal IT and cybersecurity initiatives to develop strategic recommendations that enhance system resilience, interoperability, operational capability, and organizational readiness.
Lead coordination and integration efforts across multiple organizations, programs, and stakeholder groups to ensure enterprise alignment with mission objectives, governance requirements, federal policies, and Directorate strategic priorities.
Develop, present, and defend high-level technical briefings, executive reports, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership, enabling informed decision-making, resource prioritization, and execution of mission objectives.
For supervisory positions, you will perform a full range of supervisory duties which includes assigning and evaluating work; recommending personnel actions; taking disciplinary actions; and identifying training needs and developing employees.
Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work.

To qualify for the GS-7, you must have: a) One year of directly related specialized experience equivalent to the GS-05 level: Assisting with analysis or testing of IT systems or components to support operational or mission requirements under close supervision; OR Preparing basic technical documentation or status reports in support of IT projects or system activities; OR b) Completed 1 full academic year of graduate education with (1) a major in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management OR (2) a major that provided a minimum of 24 semester hours in one or more fields of computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management, and that required the development or adaptation of applications, systems, or networks.

OR c) Completed a bachelor's degree in a field listed above and meet Superior Academic Achievement (SAA) criteria: (1) you must be in the upper third of your graduating class in the college, university, or major subdivision; or (2) you must have a 3.0 or higher out of a possible 4.0 GPA; or 3.5 or higher out of a possible 4.0 GPA based on courses completed in your major field of study during the final 2 years of the curriculum; or (3) election to membership in a national scholastic honor society (ACHS).

To qualify for the GS-9, you must have: a) One year of directly related specialized experience equivalent to the GS-07 level: Assisting others in analyzing technical or system requirements to help identify issues and support the operation of IT or mission systems; OR Assisting others in developing, testing, or maintaining software, tools, or system components to support functionality, performance, or user needs; OR b) Completed all requirements for a master's degree or equivalent graduate degree with (1) a major in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management OR (2) a major that provided a minimum of 24 semester in one or more fields of computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management, and that required the development or adaptation of applications, systems, or networks.

OR c) Completed 2 full academic years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to a master's degree or equivalent graduate degree with (1) a major in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management OR (2) a major that provided a minimum of 24 semester hours in one or more fields of computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management, and that required the development or adaptation of applications, systems, or networks.

To qualify for the GS-11, you must have: a) One year of directly related specialized experience equivalent to the GS-09 level: Supporting coordinating system monitoring activities, identifying operational issues, and directing timely resolutions that support safe and reliable mission or training operations; OR Supporting analyzing operational data and updating requirements to improve procedures, tools, and system configurations that contribute to mission readiness; OR b) Completed all requirements for a Ph.D. degree or equivalent doctoral degree with (1) a major in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management OR (2) a major that provided a minimum of 24 semester hours in one or more fields of computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management, and that required the development or adaptation of applications, systems, or networks.

OR c) Completed 3 full academic years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to a Ph.D. degree or equivalent doctoral degree with (1) a major in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management OR (2) a major that provided a minimum of 24 semester hours in one or more of fields of computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management, and that required the development or adaptation of applications, systems, or networks.

To qualify for the GS-12, you must have one year of directly related specialized experience equivalent to the GS-11 level: Coordinating system monitoring activities, identifying operational issues, and directing timely resolutions that support safe and reliable mission or training operations; OR Analyzing operational data and updating requirements to improve procedures, tools, and system configurations that contribute to mission readiness; To qualify for the GS-13, you must have one year of directly related specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level: Conducting advanced analysis of mission, operational, or system performance data to inform organizational strategies, optimize procedures or tools, and drive decisions affecting mission readiness; OR Providing technical leadership for cross-disciplinary teams, including coordinating complex workflows, delivering high-level recommendations to management, and communicating operational or system needs.

To qualify for the GS-14, you must have one year of directly related specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 level: Analyzing and resolving complex technology system or application issues to support operational performance and mission requirements; OR Leading enterprise-level analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution of highly complex technology system, application, infrastructure, and integration issues with significant impact on mission execution, operational continuity, and organizational performance across multiple functional areas.

s.h: Information Technology Specialist – Specialista ITLa posizione
s.t:
-------------
Siamo alla ricerca di un/una **Information Technology Specialist** con un approccio pratico, autonomo e proattivo, che assuma la responsabilità della gestione quotidiana, della manutenzione e del continuo miglioramento dell'infrastruttura IT e dell'ambiente digitale dell'Academy.
Il ruolo combina attività di **infrastruttura IT, amministrazione dei sistemi, networking, supporto tecnico, cybersecurity e protezione dei dati**, con particolare attenzione all'affidabilità, alla sicurezza e alla continuità dei servizi IT.
La persona selezionata sarà il principale punto di riferimento interno per le tematiche IT, fornendo supporto a dipendenti e management e collaborando con fornitori IT esterni per servizi specialistici, progetti di maggiore complessità e specifiche esigenze tecniche.
**​**

s.h: Responsabilità principali - Infrastruttura IT e sistemi
s.t:
--------------------------------------------------------
· Amministrare e mantenere i sistemi IT dell'Academy, inclusi server, infrastruttura di rete, dispositivi e software.
· Gestire gli account utente, i diritti di accesso, le autorizzazioni e le impostazioni di sicurezza.
· Configurare e mantenere laptop, stampanti, telefoni e altre apparecchiature IT.
· Essere il primo punto di contatto per i dipendenti per problematiche e richieste di supporto IT.
· Monitorare le prestazioni dei sistemi e risolvere i problemi tecnici in modo tempestivo ed efficace.
· Diagnosticare e risolvere problemi relativi a connettività di rete, VPN, Wi-Fi e infrastruttura IT.
· Pianificare e implementare aggiornamenti di sistema, patch di sicurezza e miglioramenti hardware e software.
· Garantire l'affidabilità e la disponibilità dell'infrastruttura IT, inclusi sistemi di posta elettronica, archiviazione dei dati e backup.
· Gestire e ottimizzare piattaforme cloud quali **Microsoft 365, SharePoint e Microsoft Teams**.
· Mantenere aggiornata la documentazione IT, comprese procedure, policy, guide per gli utenti e inventario di hardware e software.
· Fornire assistenza tecnica per riunioni online e ibride, webinar e conferenze.
· Partecipare a progetti di digitalizzazione, innovazione e miglioramento dei sistemi IT.
· Identificare opportunità per aumentare l'efficienza attraverso la tecnologia e l'ottimizzazione dei processi.
### Cybersecurity e protezione dei dati
· Implementare e mantenere policy, procedure e misure tecniche di cybersecurity.
· Supportare e, ove necessario, condurre valutazioni periodiche della sicurezza e attività di gestione delle vulnerabilità.
· Garantire l'adeguata implementazione e manutenzione di antivirus, sistemi di protezione degli endpoint e firewall.
· Monitorare, analizzare e gestire incidenti di sicurezza informatica e potenziali violazioni dei dati.
· Supportare le attività di sensibilizzazione e formazione del personale in materia di cybersecurity.
· Collaborare con il **Data Protection Officer (DPO)** e con le funzioni interessate per garantire il rispetto dei requisiti applicabili in materia di protezione dei dati, inclusi **GDPR e normativa svizzera sulla protezione dei dati (LPD/FADP)**.
· Supportare le procedure relative alle richieste di accesso ai dati e alle informazioni.
· Garantire che sistemi e processi IT rispettino gli standard applicabili in materia di privacy, sicurezza e protezione dei dati.
Requisiti
---------
### Formazione ed esperienza
· Laurea o formazione tecnica superiore in **Informatica, Information Technology, Sistemi Informativi** o disciplina correlata; in alternativa, **Attestato federale di capacità (AFC) di informatico/a** o qualifica equivalente.
· **3–5 anni di esperienza professionale** nell'ambito delle operations IT, dell'infrastruttura IT o dell'amministrazione di sistemi.
· Solida conoscenza pratica dell'infrastruttura IT, dei sistemi operativi e dei principi di networking.
· Buona conoscenza dei principi di cybersecurity e dei requisiti in materia di protezione dei dati.
· Esperienza pratica in un ambiente di supporto IT o amministrazione di sistemi.
### Competenze tecniche
· Amministrazione e troubleshooting di **ambienti Windows e server**.
· Conoscenza di **LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, VPN, Wi-Fi e tecnologie firewall**.
· Esperienza nella gestione degli utenti e dei relativi accessi e permessi.
· Esperienza con **Microsoft 365, SharePoint e Microsoft Teams**.
· Conoscenza di **soluzioni di backup e principi di disaster recovery/business continuity**.
· Esperienza nella gestione di aggiornamenti, patch e inventario IT.
· Familiarità con strumenti di sicurezza, protezione degli endpoint e valutazione delle vulnerabilità.
· La conoscenza di database, ad esempio **SQL**, o di sistemi ERP costituisce un vantaggio.
· La familiarità con strumenti di **Intelligenza Artificiale (AI)** e con le loro applicazioni pratiche in ambito IT/business costituisce un vantaggio.
### Competenze personali
· Ottime capacità organizzative e di problem solving.
· Approccio pratico, orientato al servizio e proattivo.
· Capacità di lavorare in autonomia e di gestire le priorità in modo efficace.
· Elevata attenzione ai dettagli e forte senso di responsabilità e riservatezza.
· Buone capacità comunicative e relazionali.
· Capacità di spiegare tematiche tecniche in modo chiaro anche a utenti non tecnici.
· **Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata.**
Cosa offre la posizione
-----------------------
Si tratta di un ruolo operativo e trasversale, con un'ampia responsabilità sull'ambiente IT dell'Academy.
La persona selezionata avrà l'opportunità di contribuire non solo alla gestione quotidiana e al supporto degli utenti, ma anche a progetti di **cybersecurity, digitalizzazione, miglioramento dell'infrastruttura e sviluppo dell'ambiente tecnologico dell'organizzazione**.
Lavorerà a stretto contatto con il management, i dipendenti, il Data Protection Officer e i partner IT esterni, contribuendo a garantire un ambiente tecnologico **sicuro, affidabile, conforme ai requisiti applicabili ed efficiente**.

*Notre succès est avant tout dû au formidable travail de nos 184 collaborateurs qui s'activent au quotidien, sur 14 sites distincts, pour viser l'excellence de nos services. Le tout dans une démarche de dynamique participative où chacun peut et doit prendre sa place pour le bien de l'entreprise.*
*Afin de renforcer notre équipe IT, nous recherchons au plus vite (mais nous sommes prêts à attendre quelque peu si vous êtes la bonne personne) pour notre siège de Givisiez :*
**Technicien de support applicatif \- IT** (H/F) 80\-100%
---------------------------------------------------------
Premier interlocuteur de nos 184 collaborateurs, vous êtes le maillon entre les utilisateurs et l'équipe IT. Votre périmètre couvre deux axes complémentaires : le support Odoo au quotidien, et l'IT interne de nos 14 sites. Un poste où l'on voit très concrètement l'effet de son travail.
**Axe 1 : Support Odoo**
* **Assurer le support de premier niveau :** traiter les tickets, e\-mails et appels avec réactivité, en priorisant les urgences et en assurant un suivi rigoureux.
* **Diagnostiquer et résoudre :** identifier les causes des dysfonctionnements, proposer des solutions et escalader ce qui doit l'être.
* **Accompagner :** guider les utilisateurs, débutants comme experts, dans la prise en main d'Odoo : sessions individuelles, tutoriels, guides documentés.
* **Remonter les tendances :** identifier les bugs récurrents et les demandes fréquentes pour proposer des améliorations fonctionnelles ou techniques à l'équipe.
**Axe 2 : IT interne**
* **Équiper et maintenir :** préparer, installer et entretenir les postes de travail et les périphériques (imprimantes, scanners, matériel des points de vente).
* **Gérer les accès :** création et suivi des comptes utilisateurs, droits et matériel à l'arrivée et au départ des collaborateurs.
* **Intervenir en premier niveau :** sur le matériel du siège, des magasins et des dépôts.
* **Être sur le terrain :** déplacements ponctuels sur nos sites.
**En transverse**
* **Participation aux projets** **:** accompagner et assister les équipes projets dans la mise en œuvre, le déploiement et le suivi des solutions.
* **Documenter :** rédiger les comptes\-rendus techniques, enrichir la base de connaissances interne et participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de support.
* **Collaborer :** travailler en étroite synergie avec les développeurs (bugs techniques) et les analystes (questions fonctionnelles).
**Votre profil**
* Expérience avérée dans le support ou l'administration d'un ERP (Odoo, SAP, Abacus, etc.) ou d'un logiciel métier similaire.
* À l'aise dans un environnement Microsoft : gestion des comptes et des accès, matériel bureautique courant.
* Pédagogue : vous vulgarisez un sujet technique et vous savez vous adapter à votre interlocuteur.
* Méthodique, avec un sens aigu des priorités.
* Bonnes compétences relationnelles et aisance à collaborer avec tous les services.
* Permis de conduire pour les déplacements sur nos sites.
* Langues : français courant ; l'allemand et l'anglais sont un atout.
**Un plus**
* Expérience en gestion de tickets (Jira ou équivalent).
* Connaissance des bases de données (PostgreSQL) ou des outils d'intégration (API, connecteurs).
* Certification ou formation Odoo en cours.
**Ce que nous offrons**
* Un ERP au centre de l'entreprise et une vraie latitude pour décider comment il évolue.
* Une entreprise familiale où les décisions se prennent vite, sans strates hiérarchiques.
* 1 jour de télétravail par semaine.
* 5 semaines de vacances.
* Formation continue et certification Odoo prises en charge.
* Des rabais collaborateurs sur l'ensemble de notre assortiment de vins et de boissons.
Chez Alloboissons, nous croyons qu'un bon système informatique, c'est avant tout une équipe soudée, curieuse et tournée vers l'avenir. Si vous partagez cet état d'esprit, **rejoignez\-nous !**
**Nos valeurs :** bienveillance – intégrité – engagement – respect – esprit d'équipe

As a Customer Support Engineer (CSE) at NetBox Labs , you are the technical partner your customers rely on. Be the technical anchor for your customers
